top news.title: Meta reports Q2 revenue up 28% YoY to $60.8B, family DAP up 3% to 3.6B on average for June, forecasts Q3 revenue below estimates; META drops 8%+ after hours

tweets.author: @munster_gene
tweets.text: $META call just wrapped.  Stock is down 9.5%, near after-hours session lows.  The drift in the stock was tied to investors less encouraged about the timing of the Cloud business.  That is a large growth lever that we will have to wait for.  The other new products, consumer personalized AI agents will be announced soon, the only problem is investors don't believe they will be impactful in the next year.

tweets.author: @firstadopter
tweets.text: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg: “the high level observation is that there's just nowhere near enough compute for all the demand. So that is why we see that like, basically we are getting a large number of offers for the compute that we have, but also we have a lot of internal uses that we think are going to be quite valuable.”

tweets.author: @charliebilello
tweets.text: Meta's Reality Labs unit lost another $4.6 billion in Q2, bringing its cumulative losses since 2020 up to $87 billion. We've never seen a public company light money on fire to this extent. $META [image]

sub_items.title: Meta reports free cash flow of $784M in Q2, down 91% YoY, and now expects 2026 capex to be $130B-$145B, compared with its prior forecast of $125B-$145B

Meta reports Reality Labs Q2 revenue up 16% YoY to $431M, vs. $423.4M est., and a $4.62B operating loss, vs. $5.07B estimated

top news.title: Microsoft reports Q4 revenue up 18% YoY to $90.1B, vs. $87.62B est., and says 365 Copilot has 30M+ paid seats, up from 20M+ in Q3; MSFT jumps 7%+ after hours

tweets.author: @firstadopter
tweets.text: This was the best Microsoft quarterly earnings report in recent memory, along with incredible Azure results/guidance and an accelerating outlook for the first half of the fiscal year. Well done.

tweets.author: @timadeline
tweets.text: Very exciting news shared today during @Microsoft's earnings reports: +50% Copilot paid seats from 20M to 30M in just 3 months. Great to see Copilot accelerate.

tweets.author: @mukund
tweets.text: Take out $MSFT @AnthropicAI “gain - mark to market” and your EPS is $4.39 vs $4.29 estimated. As I have been saying for the last few weeks. Anthropic is the tide that's lifting all profitability boats - for $GOOGL last week and today for $MSFT

sub_items.title: Microsoft reports Q4 Azure and other cloud services revenue up 43% YoY, vs. 40% est., and says Azure revenue in FY 2026 exceeded $100B for the first time
Microsoft reports Q4 Windows OEM and Devices revenue down 7% YoY, Xbox hardware revenue down 13%, and Xbox content and services revenue down 10%

top news.title: Russia charges Pavel Durov with facilitating terrorist activity, alleging that Telegram was being used by Ukrainian spies to organize attacks inside Russia

tweets.author: @0xdamx
tweets.text: Russia: you are aiding terrorism... * issues an international arrest warrant* Telegram: posts him giving the middle finger Durov: dresses his Telegram profile picture up as a terrorist. The most UNFAZED response in tech history 💀 [image]

tweets.author: @insider0x
tweets.text: Official Telegram account on X responds to news about Pavel Durov being charged with Terrorism Support in Russia. This is a historic photo that Pavel posted back in 2011 when pro-government  group tried to take over VK (it succeeded eventually).

tweets.author: @sarahadams
tweets.text: The irony is that Russia is giving an air defense system to the Taliban, the very regime harboring the head of ISIS Central Asia, Gulmurod Khalimov (yes, he's still very much alive), arguably the greatest terrorist threat to Russia itself. Yet somehow, the owner of Telegram is considered the bigger issue. As the old saying goes, never interrupt your enemy when he's making a mistake.
